title: Water rocket
spec: PET bottle airframe · 3D-printed nose cone · servo parachute release
summary: The rocket around the flight computers: a bottle rocket from a school science competition, then a clear bottle body, then a printed nose cone that splits open to let the parachute out. Mostly pictures.
